_about: Content for the Getting Started page. Edit here, then run: python3 tools/build_site.py. 'demo' is a demo id from the demo library; 'guide' is a file name in content/guides (without .json). 'plan' shows a plan label on paid features; leave null when it's in every plan.
title: Getting started
intro: Welcome to Banner Connect. Start with the four steps below, then use this page whenever you want to know what a tab in your menu is for.

start.title: Put your inquiry form on your website
start.body: This is how families reach you. Most schools are done in ten minutes.

start.title: Connect Facebook, Instagram and Google
start.body: Messages from your pages land in one inbox with your email and texts.

start.title: Connect your calendar
start.body: Visits booked online show up on the calendar you already use.

start.title: Install the mobile app
start.body: Answer families from your phone, even when you're away from your desk.

tabs.name: Dashboard
tabs.summary: How enrollment is going, at a glance.
items: How many families reach each stage, and how many move on
The total tuition of every family still deciding
Your follow-ups, with overdue ones in red
tabs.first: Open it each morning and work your task list from the top.

tabs.name: Ask AI
tabs.summary: Ask a question about your account in plain English.
items: "How many families inquired this month?" or "Who hasn't heard from us in two weeks?"
"How do I add a staff member?" and other how-to questions
tabs.first: Ask it which families are waiting on a reply.

tabs.name: CRM
tabs.summary: Every family, every conversation and every follow-up.
items: A record for each parent, with every email, text and form they've sent
One inbox for email, texts, Facebook, Instagram and Google messages
Saved replies for questions you answer often, like tuition or uniforms
Your enrollment pipeline: one card per family, from inquiry to enrolled
Follow-ups assigned to a person with a due date
A number on each family that goes up as they visit and apply, so you know who to call first
The children in each family, with grade and status
tabs.first: Open Opportunities and find the newest family in New Inquiry.

tabs.name: Calendars
tabs.summary: Visits, tours and assessments, booked online by families.
items: Every booking in a list you can search and filter
Your booking pages: campus visits, tours, assessments
Sync with Google or Outlook so nothing gets double-booked
tabs.first: Connect your Google or Outlook calendar.

tabs.name: Forms & Docs
tabs.summary: What families fill out, sign and send you.
items: Inquiry, info packet, visit request and other forms for your website
Enrollment contracts and agreements families sign online
tabs.first: Copy your inquiry form onto your website.

tabs.name: Marketing
tabs.summary: Emails and pages that bring families in and keep them close.
items: Ready-made templates and email campaigns to families
Links that tag a family or start a follow-up when clicked
Landing pages for an open house, an ad or a scholarship
Codes for flyers, banners and event tables
Short videos from happy parents for your website
tabs.first: Read the three emails new families already receive.

tabs.name: Automations
tabs.summary: The follow-up that happens on its own.
items: Already built for you: info requests, visits, events and families who go quiet
tabs.first: Look through what's already running before you build anything new.

tabs.name: Reporting
tabs.summary: Where your families come from and what's working.
items: Lead sources, appointments and email results
How your website shows up in search
Visits to your Banner Connect forms and pages
tabs.first: Check which lead source sent you the most families this year.

tabs.name: Payments
items: Send a bill and get paid online
A link for an application fee or enrollment deposit
tabs.first: Ask Banner 61 to connect your payment account before you send anything.

tabs.name: Advanced
tabs.summary: Set once, rarely touched. Banner 61 handles most of it.
items: Your school's name, address and phone, used in every email
Extra details you track, like grade of entry
Logos and photos used in emails and forms
Your web addresses and brand colors
tabs.first: Check that your school name and phone number are right in Custom Values.

tabs.name: Settings
tabs.summary: Your staff, your phone number and your email sending.
items: Add the people on your admissions team
Facebook, Instagram, Google and your calendar
tabs.first: Add everyone who answers family questions.
